newsitem.title: CANADA: Nortran Pharma gets U.S. arrhythmia patent.
newsitem.headline: Nortran Pharma gets U.S. arrhythmia patent.

text.p: Nortran Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Thursday the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office allowed Nortran's patent for a family of compounds and methods for treating arrhythmias.

Nortran said issuance of this patent will expand the protection of Nortran's library of unique "pathology-targeted" compounds which selectively block ion channels under the conditions of a hearth attack.
Nortran said pre-clinical trials the compounds have been shown to prevent the electrical chaos which causes sudden cardiac death at doses which produce little or no side-effects.
The company said the ion channel modulators have much wider potential use, including the treatment of central nervous system disorders, pain and asthma.
